text: Managers are incentivized to manage their institutions so as to avoid contingent capital triggers, and that incentive itself can optimize the governance of financial institutions.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857

isBasedOn.name: Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry

abstract: Managers are incentivized to manage their respective entities to avoid CoCo triggers, which can help optimize governance of financial institutions.

value: CoCos are outstanding with credible trigger terms
